# Bundled Font Attribution

HUMHUM bundles the following variable fonts from the official Google Fonts
repository so the approved HTML preview and Android app use identical Chinese
glyph metrics:

- Noto Sans SC
- Noto Serif SC
- Roboto Mono

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts

The fonts are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The license text
is included in the Android package at
`android/app/src/main/res/raw/noto_fonts_ofl.txt`.

The fonts are loaded locally. HUMHUM does not contact Google Fonts or another
font service at runtime.
